title: Unlacquered Brass Modern Retractable Wall Hook, 2-1/2-Inch Pull-Out, Wall-Mounted Brass, 15 Lb, Allied Brass
description: Modern retractable wall hook for bathroom use with 2-1/2 inches / 2-1/2-inch / 2.5 inch pull-out hanging space for towels, robes, and clothing in Unlacquered Brass, which is a living finish that develops a unique natural patina over time, gaining character and warmth with age. Each piece becomes one-of-a-kind, perfect for those who appreciate authentic materials that tell a story. This wall-mounted hook retracts back in when not in use for a clean look in modern bathroom hardware, contemporary bath accessories, and minimalist bathroom fixtures. Brass construction; wall mount installation for standard interior walls. Includes mounting hardware and toggle bolts; installation requires drilling a 3/4 inch dia. hole through drywall plus three small holes around the opening. Weight capacity: 15 lb. Customize the look by removing the included knob tip and replacing it with your own cabinet knob. Dimensions: 2 in L x 2 in H x 3.75 in W; projection 1 in; product weight 1 lb. Lifetime warranty. Allied Brass.
